mission_04: Hyperparameter tuning across an entire pipeline is one of the most powerful features of sklearn. Using the step__parameter naming convention, GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV can optimize hyperparameters from any step in the pipeline, not just the final estimator. This enables you to jointly optimize preprocessing choices (like polynomial degree or scaling method) alongside model hyperparameters (like tree depth or regularization strength). The grid search automatically handles the cross-validation correctly, fitting the entire pipeline from scratch for each fold and parameter combination, which prevents data leakage. This approach is essential for finding the optimal combination of preprocessing and modeling choices, and it is the standard method for hyperparameter optimization in sklearn-based workflows.
